g.text: 1. GMR Baseline: Historical unaugmented GMR. 2. GMR + DQ-CGPv3: Plug-and-play DETR Query CGP (beta=0.05, K=16) between Layer 0 & 1.

g.text: 3. GMR + DQ-CGPv3 + GEQ: Global Event Query head fine-tuned with BCE + native loss (lr=1e-5 / 3e-5, patience=10 on Val G1 mean).

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64748b

g.text: G1-AUC (%): Area Under the Curve of G-mIoU@1 across 101 discrete presence thresholds tau in [0.00, 1.00] (higher is strictly better).

g.text: Bold values: Best performance among the available ablation variants within each backbone family.
